section.title: BDAY Neo Installation
section.heading: h1
section.body:
BDAY Neo runs on any launcher that supports installing custom modloaders for Minecraft. This guide was written with Prism Launcher and SKLauncher in mind, and assumes you already have one of them installed.

At no point do we recommend using the vanilla Minecraft launcher. If you choose to use it anyway, we offer no support — any troubleshooting is on you.

Download the modpack files from Discord first. With that out of the way, let's get the modpack up and running.

Step 1 — Log In

Open your launcher of choice and log in.

On Prism Launcher, when you launch it, you should see this pop-up. Click Add Microsoft Account, then on the next pop-up either sign in with the "Sign in with Microsoft" button, or by scanning the QR code.

On SKLauncher, click either the Microsoft or SKLauncher option — this guide uses the SKLauncher option. Enter your username, then log in.

Step 2 — Create Your Instance

Once logged in, you'll land on the default home screen of your launcher.

From here we want to add a new Minecraft instance.

Prism Instructions

At the top-left of the screen, click the Add Instance button.

You'll be met with this screen.

Click Import, then Browse, and select NEOBday.mrpack. When you're done, it should look like this.

Click OK and everything will import automatically. Skip ahead to Step 3.

SKLauncher Instructions

On the left-hand side of the screen there's a large plus symbol — hover over it and it'll say New Instance. Click it.

You'll be met with this pop-up. Here you can change the instance icon and name to whatever you like.

For the Minecraft version and everything else, set it up exactly as shown here, then click Create Instance.

The instance will start downloading — let it finish before continuing.

Once it's done, right-click the instance and click Open Folder. You should see this:

Paste the contents of the minecraft folder from NEOBday.zip in here. It should look like this when you're done:

That's it for this step — move on to Step 3.

Step 3 — Configure & Launch

Almost done — all that's left is configuring the instance so everything runs smoothly.

Prism Instructions

Right-click your instance and click Edit.

Go to Settings, then the Java tab.

Configure the settings so they match this:

For Java Arguments, copy and paste this:

-XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:G1NewSizePercent=20 -XX:G1ReservePercent=20 -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=50 -XX:G1HeapRegionSize=32M

Once you're done, click Close, then launch the instance by double-clicking it.

SKLauncher Instructions

On SK it's a bit more straightforward. Right-click your instance and click Settings. Click Java & Memory and drag the slider until you reach 7680 MB, like this:

Save your changes — you're ready to play!

section.title: Updating BDAY Neo
section.heading: h1
section.body:
In the future, all modpack updates will be handled automatically by the server. For now, updates have to be done manually.

⚠ Heads up: this update will reset your keybinds. Future updates won't do this — just keep it in mind for this one.

In your launcher, right-click your instance and open the installation folder. Follow along with the video below for the rest of the steps.

Having trouble with the embedded video above? You can also watch it on YouTube.
